title: The Cooler Wall and Caffeine-Free Hydration
lessons: The player remembers the wall of CELSIUS cans at the gym cooler, every flavor louder than the last, and notices a small NSF mark buried in the noise.
The player already buys CELSIUS but chooses the caffeine-free Hydration line for situations where energy is not wanted.

text: Lights off. For some reason you're thinking about the gym cooler: a whole wall of CELSIUS cans, every flavor louder than the last, and a tiny NSF mark you only noticed on the way out.

entry-first-1.speaker: PLAYER
text: Your whole cooler wall is a shouting match. Every flavor is fighting the one next to it.

entry-first-2.speaker: CELSIUS
text: Good! A full shelf is just doing reps.

entry-first-3.speaker: PLAYER
text: Then I found this tiny NSF mark hiding in all that noise.

entry-first-4.speaker: CELSIUS
text: You found that? Nobody finds that. Some of my flavors get screened by NSF Certified for Sport, so a lab checks them for stuff that's banned in pro sports. Quiet detail. Loud can. I don't know why I whisper that part.

choice-first.speaker: CELSIUS
text: Anyway. You're in bed thinking about my cooler. Something's going on.

choices.text: The noise got me to look. The seal made me stay.
I'd still check whether this exact flavor made the certified list.
I'm not a tested athlete. The seal isn't what decides this for me.

first-1.speaker: CELSIUS
text: Okay, that's kind of my whole thing and I didn't even plan it. Loud gets you over. The little seal is what's left when I stop yelling.

first-2.speaker: CELSIUS
text: Yeah, do that. It's per flavor, not the whole wall. Check the list, not your memory of the list. I'd hate to be wrong about one and have you find out.

first-3.speaker: CELSIUS
text: Fair. It's real, it's just not for you. I'd still rather it be there than not.
Eleven at night. You want something in a can, and for once you don't want it to wake you up. The CELSIUS Hydration line is in the fridge, and it has no caffeine in it.

entry-return-1.speaker: CELSIUS
text: Surprise. No caffeine. I know, sit down.

entry-return-2.speaker: PLAYER
text: From you? Should I call someone?

entry-return-3.speaker: CELSIUS
text: Very funny. I can be in the room without turning the volume up.

entry-return-4.speaker: PLAYER
text: What's the job then, if it isn't energy?

entry-return-5.speaker: CELSIUS
text: Electrolytes. Hydration. Same name on the can, different reason to grab me at eleven at night.

choice-return.speaker: CELSIUS
text: So? Am I allowed to be quiet?

choices.text: I like that not every can has to be an energy drink.
The name still makes me expect a jolt.
If I want hydration at night, I'd rather buy a hydration brand.

return-1.speaker: CELSIUS
text: Growth. Beautiful. I still feel like I should be shouting about it. I'm not going to. I'm not!

return-2.speaker: CELSIUS
text: I know the name makes it sound like I forgot who I am.

return-2-1.speaker: PLAYER
text: A little.

return-2-2.speaker: CELSIUS
text: Read the can. It says Hydration right on it. I can't change my name at midnight, but I can label the quiet one.

return-3.speaker: CELSIUS
text: Okay. That's fair. Putting my name on hydration doesn't mean you owe me hydration. Somebody else has been doing it longer.
